scripts.build: npm run prisma:generate --workspace backend && npm run build --workspaces
scripts.clean:artifacts: node -e "for (const path of ['backend/dist','frontend/.next','frontend/tsconfig.tsbuildinfo']) require('node:fs').rmSync(path, { recursive: true, force: true })"
scripts.format: prettier --write --ignore-unknown package.json backend frontend eslint.config.js prettier.config.js
scripts.format:check: prettier --check --ignore-unknown package.json backend frontend eslint.config.js prettier.config.js
